01 · Overview

Sell out 500 Founders packs, then keep them

The plan fills 500 Founders subscriptions in launch week and grows a paid base from there. Everything before launch day builds a qualified founding list of adults who already spend on wellness, weighted about 70% women and 30% men. She is usually the household buyer, and he is often the second subscriber in the same home.

01a · Ambassador

Rita Ora, target partner and ambassador

The lead ambassador target for HoniOra. Not yet approached, so nothing goes public until a signed agreement exists.

Her focus: longevity, in her own words

"Longevity? I'm obsessed."

The Women's Health cover line, "How Rita Ora fell for wellness", sits beside strength, energy and electrolyte stories. That's HoniOra's exact territory: strength, cellular energy, hydration and a daily ritual. She chose to make longevity her public story before anyone paid her to.

Her reach

15.9MInstagram followers, 3 Nov 2026 (HypeAuditor)
1.84%Engagement rate, Nov 2026 (HypeAuditor)
~10KAverage likes per post (HypeAuditor)
Reach is not the same as fit. IQFluence estimates her Instagram audience at 62% male and 38% female, with India, Turkey and Mexico among top countries. The US share isn't published. Her following looks global and male-leaning, while HoniOra's buyer is a US woman 40 to 75. The cover story and press pull matter more than her follower count. Ask her team for audience data by country, gender and age before agreeing a fee.

Sources: HypeAuditor, IQFluence. The two disagree on engagement (1.84% vs 0.14%) because they measure it differently. Confirm which Women's Health edition ran the cover before quoting it.

Status: not yet approached

Honi means honey. Ora means life.

The name match does half the storytelling. Her Women's Health longevity feature (March 2026) shows she talks wellness in public. Her husband, Taika Waititi, grew up partly in Raukokore in the Bay of Plenty, HoniCo's home region.

Why her

  • Instant recognition for a pre-launch brand with no awareness
  • Longevity and wellness already part of her public story
  • NZ connection supports the Mānuka provenance angle
  • Press pull for the founder story and the Founders drop

Watch-outs

  • She is in her mid-30s. Core buyers are 40 to 75, so pair her with creators and practitioners who speak to that age.
  • Check her current brand deals and own ventures for supplement or beauty-from-within conflicts.
  • Celebrity fees can exceed the lean budget. Offer equity or a revenue share before cash.
Status: not yet approached

The Taika angle

From Raukokore to The Heart of America.

Why he matters

  • Grew up in Wellington's Aro Valley and in Raukokore, a small Bay of Plenty town on the East Cape.
  • His father was of Te Whānau-ā-Apanui descent, the iwi of the East Cape, where some of the most potent Mānuka is harvested.
  • He directs ads: his Pepsi commercial ran during Super Bowl LX in February 2026.
  • Married to Rita Ora since August 2022, so one approach opens two doors.

Three ways in

  • Director of the format comparison film. His humour suits the counter-clutter swap.
  • A Rita and Taika morning ritual piece for the Founders drop, if both sign.
  • A Bay of Plenty origin film: orchards, hives, East Cape Mānuka.

Handle with care

  • His whakapapa is his to share. Never use his iwi link in marketing without his consent.
  • Engage Te Whānau-ā-Apanui directly if East Cape Mānuka or the region features. Seek cultural advice on the te reo name HoniOra.
  • He needs his own agreement. A deal with Rita doesn't cover him.
  • A director of his level costs more than the lean budget allows. Lead with equity.

Background from Wikipedia: Taika Waititi. Verify with his representatives before any outreach copy uses it.

Status: not yet approached

Anna and Kieran Lahey: potential managing partners

The team that scaled Vida Glow, with Rita already beside them.

Proven successBuilt Vida Glow from a Sydney launch in 2014 to 20M+ units, "one box every four seconds" and global stockists from Selfridges to Revolve.
Management expertiseKieran runs the business. Anna leads brand and product. Together they've taken an ingestible powder into the US, UK, Europe and China, and launched Typebea into Sephora.
Rita, and through her TaikaRita is Anna's co-founder at Typebea and a long-time friend. That puts the Laheys one conversation from Rita and, through her, from Taika Waititi.

The relationship

  • Anna Lahey founded Vida Glow in Sydney in 2014. Kieran Lahey is co-founder and, in Anna's words, "runs the business".
  • Anna and Rita met at a Vida Glow relaunch event in 2021 and co-founded Typebea haircare, launched in April 2024 after three years in development.
  • Rita isn't a face-for-hire there. She joins retail pitches, talks to buyers, works with the creative team and is "opinionated about the formulations".
  • Typebea went to Sephora Canada as an exclusive in March 2026, with a rollout to 20 countries including the UK and US.
  • Rita attended Vida Glow's global rebrand launch, which marked its expansion into US, UK and European retailers.

What the Laheys bring

  • A warm, trusted route to Rita instead of a cold pitch to her management.
  • A working celebrity co-founder model: equity plus real involvement, the same model IM8 uses with Beckham.
  • Ingestibles know-how in HoniOra's exact format: collagen powders, sachets and liquids mixed into water.
  • Scale: Vida Glow reports 20M+ units sold, "one box every four seconds", 50 staff, and stockists including Selfridges, Harrods, Liberty and Revolve.
  • An Antipodean founder story next door to HoniCo's NZ one.

Approach plan

  1. US counsel drafts the ambassador terms: likeness rights, claims she can and can't make, exclusivity, term.
  2. Approach Anna and Kieran Lahey first, pitched as potential managing partners with Rita as founding ambassador. Fall back to her management with the founder story, the NZ link and a pilot stick kit. Pitch Taika separately through his own representatives as director of the brand film.
  3. Propose a founding partner role: equity or revenue share, a Founders drop moment and three content pieces.
  4. Only after signature: announce at L-6, feature her in the Founders drop and press kit.
Fallback. If she passes, the plan still works on creators. Keep the launch calendar independent of her answer.
01b · HoniCo story

Born in the Bay of Plenty. 1% for the bees.

A small NZ Mānuka honey company that lives at the source of its ingredients. This is the story behind every price point, every creator brief and every press pitch.

NZ provenance

HoniCo is based in the Bay of Plenty, NZ's main kiwifruit and feijoa growing region, where beekeeping is part of orchard life. To the east, the Te Urewera range and East Cape yield some of the most potent raw Mānuka honey.

01c · Manufacturing partner

NZ actives, made in Minnesota by Ourvita

Ourvita's Minneapolis site is HoniOra's contract manufacturer. It started life in 1995 as Amerilab Technologies, an effervescent specialist, and now builds effervescent powders and stick packs for a global CDMO group. Making the stick in the US puts production close to the launch market.

1995Founded as Amerilab Technologies. Joined Ourvita in 2020.
220,000+Square feet of facility, 17,000+ sq ft of controlled production suites
200+Employees at the Minneapolis site
3Effervescent tablet patents held by the site

Why Ourvita fits HoniOra

  • Effervescent is the specialty: effervescent powders and tablets, high-speed tableting and tube filling.
  • Stick pack filling plus automated cartoning for packs of 8 to 30 sticks.
  • FDA registered, cGMP compliant and NSF certified.
  • In-house QC with UPLC, HPLC, ICP-MS and FTIR, plus stability programmes.
  • Formulation, R&D, prototyping and packaging under one roof.
  • Group reach for the global plan: 15 facilities in Italy, Germany, Austria, Poland, the UK, the US and China.

At the 1,500-subscriber target, the base uses about 52,500 sticks a month, so one run covers launch plus roughly six more weeks. Excludes overage, QC retains and losses. 03 · Messages

Lead with the solution. Reveal the stack.

The format comparison is the strongest hook. Show the counter of tubs, scoops and capsules, then one stick into one glass.

Your whole morning stack in one delicious glass. 22 full-dose actives, born in New Zealand, ready in 60 seconds.

Trial results come from the individual ingredients at the doses stated, not from HoniOra itself.

Ease of use

One stick. One big glass of water. Done.

Compare formats factually. Never name or disparage a competitor brand in public.
Flavour

Yuzu, passionfruit, Mānuka honey, gold and green kiwifruit, mango and blackcurrant. Not grass clippings.

Back "delicious" with a blind taste panel before launch.
Longevity investment

Strength, energy, gut and brain as you age.

5,000 mg Cr.01 creatine, Kaneka Ubiquinol, NMN, taurine, citicoline. Structure and function wording only.
Results-driven science

Every active at a studied dose. Every study linked.

Evidence is ingredient-level, not a finished-product trial. Say so.
Ritual upgrade

Swap the counter clutter for a ritual worth keeping.

Founders steel bottle, visible real fruit in the glass.
Provenance

MGO 850+ Mānuka and NZ super-fruits, traced to source.

Keep MGO and UMF certificates on file.

Keep "Veblen" out of consumer copy. Price signals quality through restraint: a clean pack, a capped founders offer, no discounting outside the founding price.

Placement plan

  1. Request the Hearst media kit for Women's Health and Prevention: audience age, income, newsletter reach, branded content rates and supplement ad rules.

Case study 1: IM8, the premium longevity drink

  • Launched December 2024. US$60.1M revenue in FY2025.
  • About US$200M annualised by May 2026. 2026 guidance US$210M to 220M.
  • About 79% of new customers subscribe. Gross margin about 64%.
  • Marketing ran at 38.5% of FY2025 revenue, now backed by US$1B of General Catalyst growth financing.
  • David Beckham is co-founder. Athlete ambassadors Aryna Sabalenka and Ollie Bearman are shareholders.

IM8 revenue by market, FY2025

US 39.7%CA 14.7%UK 12.8%Rest 23.5%

United States 39.7%Canada 14.7%United Kingdom 12.8%Australia 5.3%Singapore 4.0%30+ other countries 23.5%

The lesson for HoniOra. A premium longevity drink earned over 60% of year-one revenue outside the US, in 30+ countries. The ambassador-as-shareholder model is the template for the Rita Ora approach.

Case study 2: grüns, taste and format win

  1. Aug 2023DTC launch, US$80 for 28 servings
  2. Dec 2023Amazon
  3. Oct 2024Profitable, month 14
  4. Feb 2025Target, then Walmart and Sam's Club

grüns raised about US$50M to 55M in total, ran Meta hook testing with landing pages per customer type and reached 6,000+ retail doors. Unilever has not confirmed the price. The lesson: a format people enjoy daily (gummies there, a fizzing glass here) beats a better label people abandon.

Global potential once the US is established

If HoniOra matched IM8's year-one split, the US would be about 40% of revenue, so every US$1 in the US pairs with about US$1.50 elsewhere. That puts global revenue near 2.5 times US revenue. Treat that as a scenario from one case study, not a forecast.

09 · Risks

The biggest risk sits in the claims

A premium price invites scrutiny. Fix these before any paid spend.

RiskWhy it mattersMitigation
Rita Ora shown before she signsUsing her name or image as partner before an agreement implies a false endorsement. Quoting Women's Health raises copyright."Rita Rocks" already pulled from the site. Internal plans only until signature. Counsel drafts terms.
GLP-1, lipid and blood pressure wordingEdges toward disease claims under FDA and FTC rules.US regulatory review of every ad, page and creator brief.
Ingredient evidence read as product evidenceTrials used single ingredients, often at other doses.Say "ingredient research" every time. Run the home-use study.
Creator off-script claimsA creator's words are the brand's claims.Written do and don't list, script approval, takedown clause.
Partisan channel backlashPolitical buys alienate the other half of the market.Founders decide first. Product-only reads.
Launch date slipsA warm list cools.Low paid spend until the date locks. Monthly list content.
Price resistance at US$196First-time buyers balk.Lead with the credited 7 Day Pack. Show cost per day.
10 · Next steps

Three decisions unlock the plan

Launch date, budget and claims sign-off. Then the rest moves.

  • Set a target launch date inside Q2 2027
  • Approach Rita Ora's team as target ambassador, via the Laheys first
  • Set a total budget and an allowable cost per subscriber
  • Brief US counsel on site claims, the Rita Ora feature and the comparison concept
  • Decide on political channel buys as founders
  • Request media kits from Mindy Pelz, MeidasTouch, David Pakman and Physionic
  • Order pilot sticks from Ourvita for panels and creator seeding
  • Get quotes for NSF Contents Certified or USP Verified, and publish batch test results
  • Use one weight line in all copy: 20 g stick with 15.2 g of actives
